noClustersConfigured: No clusters configured. Add a cluster first.
noScansYet: No scans have been run yet. Click "Scan Now" to check for vulnerabilities.
startJobTitle_one: Start the rolling update on {{count}} node?
startJobTitle_other: Start the rolling update on {{count}} nodes?
startJobNodesUnread: Nexara could not read which nodes the job updates.
startJobOrderOne: Nexara takes the nodes one at a time, in the order the job lists them.
startJobOrderMany: Nexara takes the nodes {{count}} at a time, in the order the job lists them.
startJobDrain: Each node is drained first: its VMs migrate live to other nodes, its containers restart on them, and a guest with a PCI or USB device is shut down where it is.
startJobHARules: Before the drain, the HA rules that name one of the node's guests are turned off until the job ends.
startJobInPlace: Guests are not moved: each node is updated with its guests running.
startJobUpgradeSSH: Nexara then upgrades the node's packages over SSH.
startJobUpgradeManual: The job then waits at the node until you upgrade it yourself and click Confirm Upgrade.
startJobRebootIfAsked: Then the node is rebooted if the upgrade asks for a reboot.
startJobRebootInPlace: Then the node is rebooted, unless a guest is running on it.
startJobRebootInPlaceNever: The node is not rebooted; if the upgrade asks for a reboot, it is marked Reboot required.
startJobHealth: Nexara waits for the node to come back healthy before it takes the next one.
startJobRestore: Guests moved off a node are migrated back once it is healthy.
startJobPauses: DRS and Proxmox's automatic rebalancing are paused for the cluster until the job ends.
cancelJobPending: The job has not started, so nothing on the cluster changes. A cancelled job cannot be started again: to run it, create it again.
cancelJobActive: No further node is started, and a cancelled job cannot be resumed. A node in the middle of a step is left where it stopped: a drain or a restore stops after the guest it is moving, and guests already moved stay where they are; an upgrade already running finishes, but the node is not rebooted; a node already rebooting comes back without a health check; a node waiting for Confirm Upgrade stays as it is. Nodes already updated stay updated. Nexara then turns back on the DRS, rebalancing and HA rules the job turned off, and starts again any guest the drain shut down.
sshTestNotRoot: This account is not root. Sensor readings work, but automated upgrades need root and stop at each node before it is drained.
summaryPurpose: Known vulnerabilities on each node, and rolling package updates.
summaryNoScans: No vulnerability scan has run for this cluster yet
